title: LS Pro Skater proto made with LSDE
author: djmisterjon
selftext:
Play with a cheated robot.  
Stack Rust vanilla, pure physics, and no scripted animation and translate in 10 languages (voices)  
Imagine what [LSDE ](https://lepasoft.com/en/software/ls-dialog-editor)can do for your game after years of work  
Translate in 10 languages in only 2 days and one click
